features: Large 6.7-Inch HD+ Display: Enjoy a spacious 17.02 cm HD+ screen for watching videos, browsing websites, viewing photos and using everyday apps with clear visuals and an immersive viewing experience.

50MP Dual Rear Camera: Capture detailed everyday photos with the 50MP primary camera and add creative depth to your shots with the 2MP secondary camera, while the 8MP front camera supports selfies and video calls.

5000mAh Battery: Stay connected throughout your daily routine with a 5000mAh battery designed for regular calling, browsing, entertainment, social media and other everyday smartphone activities without frequent charging.

Dimensity 6300 Processor: Powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 processor, the smartphone supports responsive multitasking, app switching, web browsing, content streaming and other daily activities with dependable performance.

4GB RAM and 128GB Storage: The 4GB RAM supports everyday multitasking, while 128GB internal storage provides space for applications, photos, videos and documents, with expandable storage support up to 1500GB for additional content.
description: Experience dependable everyday performance with a 5G smartphone designed for smooth connectivity, entertainment and multitasking. Powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 processor, it delivers responsive performance for switching between apps, browsing, streaming and everyday tasks. The 5000mAh battery provides lasting power for calls, entertainment, navigation and other daily activities, while fast charging support helps you spend less time connected to a charger. The large display offers an immersive viewing experience with vibrant colours and clear details, making it suitable for watching videos, browsing content and enjoying social media. Capture everyday moments with the 50MP camera, designed to deliver detailed photos across portraits, selfies and daily scenes. The fingerprint sensor provides convenient access and helps keep personal information protected. Voice calls are enhanced with technology designed to reduce background noise for clearer conversations in different surroundings.
